posts.name: Indecision101
posts.cooked:
Well, I finally have a group of 5 friends who enjoy the game enough to actually want to play it. Tonight, we had Chrono Ranger, Haka, Omnitron X, Fanatic, and Unity against Akash Bhuta at Insula Primalis..and we lost. We weren't doing so bad to begin with, but a string of environment targets/villain targets kind of messed us up, and in the end we were unable to defeat her.

 

This, however, is good, because I feel like my friends think that we should always win and it should always be easy. My friends reaction to finding out that if Omnitron took 5 damage, he loses all his ongoings that say that. So it was a good learning experience for hopefully many more in the future.

posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked: Hehe yup - that is one of the main reasons it's such a good combo. The Obsidian Fields kinda help as well, though. Managed to get the full uber-combo out once on Ra - Imbued Fire, Flesh of the Sun God, Staff of Ra, both Solar Flares, and buffs from Legacy (Inspiring Presence and Galvanise), and for a brief turn or two (before somebody Disrupted the Field) managed to enjoy the benefit of all three Obsidian Fields. It was ridiculous - Ra was doing something like twelve damage with his one-point nukes, and using more than one attack per turn (one-shots plus powers, probably played a Flame Spike on more than one turn as well). It's nice when you can just sit back and kill everything without worrying about some realy horrible card coming out and smashing you to bits or breaking your stuff (or, in Omni-10's case, both at once :P).
